verdict.rationale: Temporal supports automatic reactions to events — Activity failures auto-trigger retries, Schedules auto-start Workflows at specified times, and Signals/Queries let external events drive in-flight Workflow logic — but this is achieved via Workflows-as-Code rather than a declarative 'rules engine' interface (docs explicitly state 'Temporal isn't a no-code Workflow engine'). Community evidence confirms deterministic, resumable execution and retry semantics work as described, but also flags rough edges around error handling/anomaly detection when automated recovery doesn't behave as expected. missing for 10: a declarative rule-definition surface (vs. code), and stronger independent evidence that event-triggered automation works robustly in production edge cases.
